defaultContent.headline: Frequently asked questions
defaultContent.subheadline: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.question: How long does it take to launch a site?
items.answer: Most teams ship a polished marketing site within a day. The editor handles the design system, performance, and SEO so you can focus on content.

items.question: Can I use my own custom domain?
items.answer: Yes. Connect any domain you own, and we will provision SSL automatically. You can also export your site to host wherever you like.

items.question: Do you support team collaboration?
items.answer: Absolutely. Invite teammates, leave inline comments, and review changes before they ship. Real-time presence keeps everyone in sync.

items.question: What about accessibility and SEO?
items.answer: Every section is built to WCAG 2.1 AA standards out of the box. Pages are pre-rendered and ship with structured data, sitemaps, and clean semantic HTML.

items.question: Can I cancel any time?
items.answer: Yes — cancel from your dashboard whenever you like. Your site will continue running until the end of your billing period.
